decisions.reason: Selecting the three-pin J_BAT connector part does not change the existing requirement to route the battery NTC through J_BAT.
The battery connector part selection does not affect charge-status display through the SK6812 chain on GPIO13.
The connector part selection does not change the AXP2101 electrical protection behavior or cutoff settings.
The battery connector selection does not alter the MT3608 enable control, default state, or sensor-power usage.
The selected connector part does not explicitly change the established placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole-clearance constraints.

The client raises splitting the 13-pin interboard connection into power and signal connectors as a question rather than a confirmed decision; modifying the existing JST-GH interface would require clarification or a later client decision.
The battery connector selection is unrelated to the USB connector, USB data lines, and USB sourceability requirement.
The battery connector part selection does not change the SK6812 power or GPIO13 data interface.
No board dimensions, mounting arrangement, enclosure orientation, or USB-C placement constraint is changed by the connector part selection.
